# HAL - Archive Ouverte

> HAL is a multidisciplinary open-access research repository operated by CNRS and CCSD for archiving and sharing scientific publications, theses, and media across all disciplines.

HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne) is France's primary open science infrastructure, providing free access to research outputs including peer-reviewed articles, dissertations, and multimedia content. The platform supports self-archiving and institutional repositories while maintaining accessibility standards and compliance with French and European regulations.

## Main Repositories

- [HAL Home](https://hal.science): HAL open science research repository by CNRS and CCSD
- [HAL-SHS](https://shs.hal.science): HAL-SHS humanities and social sciences specialized repository
- [TEL - Theses en Ligne](https://theses.hal.science): HAL Theses repository for PhD and HDR dissertations
- [MédiHAL](https://media.hal.science): MédiHAL scientific images and media repository

## Discovery & Access

- [Search & Browse Portal](https://hal.science/browse/portal): HAL search and browse portal for research documents
- [HAL Monitor](https://monitor.hal.science): Real-time monitoring dashboard for HAL collection analytics

## About & Information

- [About HAL](https://about.hal.science): Information about HAL multidisciplinary open-access archive
